knowledge_graph.title: Pendleton Heights High School
knowledge_graph.description: Pendleton Heights High School, also known as "PHHS," is a public high school in Pendleton, Indiana. It is part of the South Madison Community School Corporation and has an enrollment of around 1,400 students.

text_blocks.snippet: Pendleton Heights High School is a public high school located at 1 Arabian Drive in Pendleton, Indiana.

list.snippet: District: South Madison Community School Corporation
Offers Advanced Placement (AP) coursework and Project Lead The Way curriculum.
Competes in regional athletics as part of the Indiana High School Athletic Association (IHSAA).
